title: spec: the bulk-param prescription says a field's allowCreate does not reach the action param dialog, which is false once #36919 lands
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a wrong authoring sentence, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7127407670). Source: L2 7127384605 on PR #36919 (#36865), point S3, a finding outside that PR's files.

Blocked-by: #36919

## What happens

When an author puts a widget-config key on a bulk action param, `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` refuses it with the `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` prescription. That text lists the field keys that reach the dialog through a promoted action (a field-backed `{ field }` param), and leaves `allowCreate` off that list. So it tells the author that a field's `allowCreate` does not reach the dialog.

PR #36919 makes an action's lookup param honour the borrowed field's `allowCreate`. Once it merges, the refusal tells authors (and the AI building through the same contract) the opposite of what the platform does.

reach: every author or AI client who puts `allowCreate` on a bulk action param and reads the refusal.

## Expected

The prescription names `allowCreate` among the keys that a promoted action carries, worded to match what #36919 ships. Any test or pin that quotes the prescription text is updated with it.

## Acceptance

- The prescription matches #36919's behaviour for `allowCreate`, and every other key it names is still true on main.
- The pins that quote the text are updated in the same PR.

Dedupe: no open issue names `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS`.
